scope: Deutschland · Zivil- und Strafverfahren (getrennt gekennzeichnete Verweise)

esig_regulation.basis: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183. VDG § 1(1): the Trust Services Act gives effect to the trust-service provisions of the Regulation in its current version. ZPO § 371a(1): private electronic documents with a qualified electronic signature follow the rules on the evidential value of private documents.

data_access_basis.basis: A private party needs a lawful basis under GDPR Art. 6(1), for example legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)); data on criminal offences needs official authority or a legal authorisation (Art. 10). A person can request their own data (Art. 15) within the Art. 12(3) period. Processing by public bodies competent for criminal offences is governed by BDSG Part 3 (§ 45).

timestamp_recognition.basis: Art. 41(1): a time stamp is not denied legal effect or admissibility solely because it is electronic or not qualified. Art. 41(2): a qualified time stamp is presumed accurate as to date and time and integrity of the bound data. Art. 42(1) sets the qualified requirements; Art. 24a(6) recognises qualified time stamps across Member States.

evidence_rules.basis: The court decides by free conviction whether a factual assertion is true and states its reasons; statutory rules of evidence bind it only where the ZPO says so.
An electronic document is offered as evidence by inspection (Augenschein), by presenting or transmitting the file.

Signed private documents give full proof that the statements come from the signatories; for electronic documents this applies with a qualified electronic signature. The appearance of authenticity from a verified qualified signature can be shaken only by facts raising serious doubt.
The court decides on the result of the taking of evidence by free conviction drawn from the whole of the main hearing.

dpa.name: Aufsichtsbehörde des Landes (nichtöffentliche Stellen); Bundesbeauftragte für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit (BfDI)
dpa.name_en: State data protection supervisory authority for private bodies; Federal Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information

review_updates.scope: Added trust-service, time-stamp, data-access, evidence-rule and supervisory-authority references from gesetze-im-internet.de and EUR-Lex texts opened on this date. expert_role keeps its earlier check date. Research draft for review by a lawyer admitted in Germany.
